title: Higher Education Loan Scheme
summary: Higher Education Loan Scheme — Government Scheme study notes covering operational framework and key exam parameters.

blocks.title: 📋 Scheme Study Overview
blocks.text: Verified standalone scheme summary. Key administrative parameters and operational guidelines.

items: Offers up to ₹10 lakh for students pursuing higher education, targeting 1 lakh students per year. It
provides a 3% interest subvention, flexible repayment terms (up to 15-20 years), and is available for
both domestic and international studies. Eligibility includes Indian nationals with admission to
recognized institutions. Required documents include proof of admission, KYC, and income details.
The scheme also offers grace periods and financial relief for unemployed graduates.
